title: Lead Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Canada

 What You Will Do

 We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI. This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice. As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.

 If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:

• Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.

• Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.

• Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.

• Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.

• Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.

• Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.

 What You Will Bring to the Table

 We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

• 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).

• Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.

• Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.

• A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.

• Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.

• Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.

• A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

 Bonus:

• Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required).

• Experience in multi-product B2B SaaS, or with HR/people-data or other sensitive-data workflows.

 If you have strong experience with integrations, APIs, or platform products, even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for strong product thinkers with deep technical fluency, not perfect resumes.

 Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

 __

 The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

 Benefits: Lattice offers eligible Canada-based employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; mental health and wellness support; emergency weather support; 16 weeks of paid parental leave; flexible time off, 13 company holidays, and 3 recharge days; a monthly remote-work stipend and one-time home-office setup stipend; an RRSP contribution match of up to 3% of gross pay (maximum $2,500 CAD annually); and a $500 CAD annual Learning & Development reimbursement. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements.

The Account Executive, Vertical Sales is a hunter-focused role responsible for driving new programmatic advertising revenue with in-house marketing teams and brands across the B2B vertical. Reporting to the Sales Director, you’ll focus on generating new business, building strategic relationships with brand-direct advertisers, and expanding StackAdapt’s footprint within the B2B market.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company, though our Sales teams are regionalized. For this role, we are prioritizing candidates based in London, UK and surrounding areas to support in-market relationship building and client engagement.

What You'll Be Doing

title: Vice Principal, Quality of Education and Raising Standards
description:
Campion School is seeking a Vice Principal for Quality of Education and Raising Standards to join us from January 2027.

Joining Campion means becoming part of a community with a clear purpose, strong foundations and a genuine ambition for the future. We are looking for colleagues who believe in the potential of every young person, embrace our values and are excited by the opportunity to help shape the next chapter of our school’s journey.

If you are looking for the next exciting step in your professional journey, we look forward to hearing from you.

This role provides strategic leadership for driving standards and securing outstanding educational provision and outcomes for every student. The Vice Principal will lead a rigorous, evidence-informed approach to school improvement, using detailed analysis of performance data to identify strengths, diagnose underperformance, establish priorities and secure sustained improvements in the quality of education and student outcomes across all key stages.

The postholder will ensure that data analysis is purposeful, forensic and closely connected to the quality of teaching, curriculum implementation, assessment, student progress and the impact of intervention. They will ensure that decisions are informed by robust evidence and that improvement strategies result in measurable gains in achievement for all students.

A central responsibility of the role is to provide high-quality strategic line management of Assistant Principals, establishing a culture of professional challenge, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Through clear strategic direction, purposeful monitoring, coaching and evaluation, the Vice Principal will ensure that Assistant Principals lead their respective areas effectively and make a demonstrable contribution to the school’s priorities and outcomes.

The postholder will work closely with the Principal and Senior Leadership Team to establish high expectations, secure consistently high standards and ensure that the school delivers an ambitious, inclusive and high-quality education for all learners.

If you wish to discover more about this exciting opportunity, need any further information or would like to have an informal discussion please contact Ross Laird at our recruitment partner Academicis on rlaird@academicis.co.uk or by phone on 07901 585959 / 01223 907979

Visits to the school are warmly encouraged, please contact Academicis for further information. All applications should be submitted via our recruitment partner Academicis. Further details can be found via www.academicis.co.uk/apply/

The closing date for receipt of completed applications is Wednesday 21st October 2026

title: Communication Support Worker
description:
Applicants must have British Sign Language (BSL) Level 2 minimum.

We are recruiting for a communication Support Worker to join our Deaf Access Team .The team is well-established and comprises of highly skilled and experienced Communication Support Workers and Sign Language Interpreters who provide communication support to Deaf students within the College and local community. We also operate a communication support agency providing communication support to Deaf people in Derby and the surrounding areas.

The Opportunity

This role offers a rewarding opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of deaf students and apprentices by ensuring they are fully included in every aspect of college life. By working proactively to identify and meet each learner’s individual needs, the post-holder will play a key part in helping students achieve their full potential—academically, socially, and personally. In doing so, the role directly contributes to improving student retention and achievement, while fostering an inclusive, supportive environment where every learner can thrive. There are also ad-hoc events to get involved with throughout the year, such as open evenings and work placements and promoting Deaf Awareness Week to DCG colleagues.

We have various hours available.

For a full explanation of the roles and responsibilities, please see the Job Description here.

About you

This role is for someone who is an excellent communicator, highly organised, and able to build strong, supportive relationships with a diverse range of deaf learners. You will be confident working independently as well as collaboratively within a team, demonstrating a strong customer‑focused approach and a genuine commitment to valuing and embracing diversity. With solid knowledge of the Equality Act 2010 and experience supporting deaf learners in an educational setting, you bring an understanding of current approaches, research, and practical support methods—including sign support and notetaking—to meet a wide range of individual needs. Ideally, you will also have experience within an FE environment, an awareness of curriculum areas such as ESOL, and knowledge of SEND reforms, the Social Model of Disability, and ALS funding. You will hold at least Level 2 BSL and Level 2 qualifications in English and Maths, alongside (or working towards) a Level 3 qualification in Communication Support for Deaf Learners or Supporting Teaching & Learning. Additional IT skills, advanced BSL, and notetaking qualifications would further enhance your suitability.

title: After School Club Assistant
description:
St Edward’s CE Primary School

St Edward’s CE Primary School has an exciting opportunity for an inspiring, enthusiastic and caring individual to join our wraparound care team as an After School Club Assistant.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about working with children and can provide a safe, welcoming and stimulating environment where pupils can relax, play and enjoy a range of activities after the school day.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 3:00 pm - 6:00 pm Term Time Only.

Key Responsibilities
  • Plan and organise activities: Prepare and organise a range of fun, active and stimulating activities, providing children with safe, creative and enjoyable play opportunities.
  • Maintain records: Undertake basic administrative tasks, including accurate record-keeping.
  • Promote positive behaviour: Encourage good behaviour and ensure that children are supported in accordance with school policies.
  • Promote healthy eating: Provide pupils with a range of healthy food and drink options, encouraging them to make choices and develop positive attitudes towards healthy eating.
  • Ensure health and safety: Maintain a safe environment by ensuring equipment is safe, hygiene standards are high and safety procedures are followed at all times. Ensure fire safety and evacuation procedures are carried out effectively.
  • Provide first aid: Administer first aid when appropriate. Training will be provided.
  • Communicate effectively: Liaise with parents and carers, school representatives and other childcare and play-related agencies.
  • Record and report incidents: Accurately record accidents and incidents, inform parents and carers as appropriate, and follow the school’s health and safety and safeguarding procedures.
  • Maintain a clean and secure environment: Ensure all equipment and materials are cleared away after use, leaving the premises clean, tidy and secure.
The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic, responsible and committed to supporting children’s well-being, development and enjoyment. The successful candidate will help create a positive and inclusive atmosphere where every child feels safe and valued.

If you enjoy working with children and would like to make a positive difference to their after school experience, we would love to hear from you.

Visits during the school day are welcome and encouraged. Please contact the school office, via email admin@stedwards.dhmat.org.uk or by phone, 01743 718462.

The Marlborough Science Academy

St Albans Herts AL1 2QA

You will be working in a thriving faculty, with a team of experienced, kind and supportive colleagues, and you will be teaching in a harmonious, modern and highly thought of area within the school and given every opportunity to perfect your craft as well as develop skills for your future.   • Kindness
  • Compassion
  • Courage
  • Endeavour

title: Senior Manager, Quality, Volume Tiers
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://careers.airbnb.com/life-at-airbnb/

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 The Community You Will Join:

 The Senior Quality Lead, Volume Tiers is the single accountable leader for quality measurement, insights, and continuous improvement across Airbnb's highest-volume Community Support functions. This role owns the end-to-end quality program for:

• Global English (GE)

• Rest of World (ROW; which is comprised of 9 different languages)

• Elevated Support

 GE and ROW span across multiple service tiers: Resolutions 1, 2, and 3, Dedicated Service Support (DSS), Dedicated Managed Host Support (DMHS); supported across a global partner network operating 24/7 in dozens of languages.

 The Difference You will Make:

 This is a senior leadership role operating at the intersection of strategy and execution. The Senior Quality Lead will break down silos within the Quality organization, establish a unified operating model, and leverage AI-powered tools to scale quality insights. This leader will work closely with Service Delivery, Training, Business Process Improvement, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, remediate issues, and ensure Airbnb is providing its global partner network a unified set of priorities.

 The successful candidate will establish themselves as a credible partner to stakeholders and be recognized internally as the voice of quality for the Volume Tier portfolio.

 A Typical Day:

 Strategic Leadership & Program Ownership

• Own and execute the Volume Tier quality strategy aligned to several critical priorities: breaking silos, aligning with stakeholders, defining a clear operating model, and driving measurable impact.

• Consolidate fragmented QA frameworks across GE and ROW into a unified operating model, eliminating inconsistent processes, divergent NPS detractor approaches, and incompatible quality signals.

• Represent Volume Tier quality in WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and cross-functional planning forums; bring a proactive, narrative-led perspective that gives leadership visibility before problems surface in operational reviews.

 Measurement & Quality Execution

• Oversee QA evaluation execution across all Volume Tier partner sites globally, ensuring consistent application of QA processes and frameworks.

• Lead root cause analysis on systemic failures, translating QA findings into product, process, and policy recommendations that go beyond agent-level coaching.

• Formalize Audit the Auditor as an ongoing control: define sample selection, alignment thresholds, root cause review, and evaluator-level remediation processes.

• Ensure every evaluation closes with a documented coaching action; build the tracking mechanisms to measure whether coaching is translating into performance improvement over time.

 Insights, Reporting & Stakeholder Partnership

• Establish automated KPI reporting across all Volume Tier sites, tiers, and languages, eliminating manual processes.

• Unify NPS detractor analysis across GE and ROW, ensuring global patterns surface in real time.

• Build a Partner QA Performance Scorecard, establishing clear accountability for Calibration Accuracy, Evaluation Completeness, Critical Error Detection, Coaching Effectiveness.

 AI & Technology Enablement

• Lead the deployment of AutoQA (via Observe.AI) across Volume Tiers; partner with the Platform team to ensure appropriate sequencing.

• Build and govern a clear accountability framework for AI-assisted quality tools and processes.

 People & Culture Leadership

• Lead a globally distributed team of Partner Quality Leads and Quality Insights Analysts.

• Foster a One-Quality-Team culture that eliminates the cross-team divides: shared best practices, cross-regional learning, and proactive knowledge sharing.

• Set high expectations and hold the team accountable for output quality, insight delivery, and stakeholder engagement.

• Partner closely with peers to ensure one consistent quality voice across the portfolio.

 Your Expertise:

• 12+ years of experience in Customer/Community Support, Quality Assurance, or Contact Center Operations, with direct accountability for large-scale, multilingual QA programs.

• 5+ years managing globally distributed QA teams across multiple languages, regions, and partner organizations in a 24/7 support environment.

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience, preferably in related field; MBA or Masters preferred

• Experience with QA tooling platforms, including hands-on ownership of form design, calibration management, and AutoQA deployment.

• Deep expertise in quality methodologies (COPC, AQS, Six Sigma, Lean), with a proven ability to apply them to high-volume, complex support environments.

• Demonstrated track record of leading quality transformation, consolidating fragmented programs, driving measurable improvement in NPS/CSAT, and QA calibrations.

• Experience deploying or scaling AI/ML assisted QA tools (AutoQA, predictive NPS/CSAT).

• Strong executive presence: able to influence senior stakeholders, present a unified quality narrative in leadership forums, and drive alignment across stakeholders.

• Experience managing vendor partner governance: calibration oversight, performance improvement plans, and escalation frameworks.

 Preferred

• COPC certification; Six Sigma Green or Black Belt.

• Experience with Observe.AI.

• Background in program management, change management, or organizational design within a high-growth tech environment.

• Experience working in or closely with BPO/vendor governance models at scale (1,000+ partner FTEs across multiple sites and geographies).

 Your Location:

 This position is Canada - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, Alberta, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.

 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

 Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

 We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

 We use automated tools to help our recruiting team efficiently screen a large volume of applications. All final hiring decisions are made by a human reviewer.

 This role is newly created and does not replace or backfill an existing position.

 How We'll Take Care of You:

 Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

 Canada Annual Pay Range

 $160,000—$200,000 CAD

 Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

 A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: VP, Finance
description:
Headquarters: United States

 URL: https://engine.com/

 About the Role

 We're looking for a VP, Finance to lead Finance at Engine and serve as a strategic partner to our CEO and executive leadership team.

 You'll own the financial strategy and operating cadence of the company, from planning and forecasting to capital allocation, business performance, financial reporting, and long-range strategy. You'll help leadership understand what is driving the business, where we should invest, and what we need to do next. You'll also be the architect of Engine's financial story, shaping how the company is understood by its Board, investors, and partners.

 You'll build the Finance organization and infrastructure to support Engine through its next phase of growth. That means creating clarity where there is ambiguity, building scalable processes before they become bottlenecks, and using data, systems, and AI to make Finance increasingly leveraged.

 Success in this role will be measured by business impact and the results of the Finance organization.

 What You'll Do

 Strategic Financial Leadership

• Serve as the CEO's financial thought partner on growth strategy, investment priorities, resource allocation, and profitability. Drive capital allocation decisions across the executive team — where Engine invests people, capital, and resources, and where we make tradeoffs. Bring financial rigor to pricing, monetization, new products, markets, and partnerships.

 Capital Strategy & Transactions

• Own fundraising, debt and liquidity strategy, M&A, and other strategic transactions. Build investor relationships, lead the Board story on performance, and prepare Engine for future capital events — including the reporting, controls, and governance a public-ready company requires (SOX readiness, audit committee partnership, external guidance frameworks).

 Financial Planning & Business Insight

• Own the financial plan — quarterly forecasting, long-range modeling, scenario analysis, and the operating cadence across Engine. Develop a deep understanding of revenue, margins, customer economics, pricing, payment economics, and cash flow. Build the metrics and frameworks that make the business legible to leadership.

 Narrative & Communication

• Tell Engine's financial story to the Board, investors, lenders, and partners — turning complex numbers into a narrative leadership can act on and external audiences believe. Lead financial reporting and help the CEO communicate performance, outlook, risks, opportunities, and key decisions with clarity.

 Build Finance for Scale

• Build and lead a high-performance Finance team — attracting exceptional talent, modernizing through AI and automation, and establishing systems, processes, data infrastructure, and controls that scale without creating bureaucracy. Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Legal, and external advisors to ensure Engine has the financial foundation required to scale responsibly.

 What You'll Bring

 Experience and Background

• 12+ years of experience across investment banking, private equity, growth equity, corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or a related field, with significant experience in high-growth technology.

• Investment banking or private equity background, with hands-on experience in valuation, transaction execution, and capital markets. Strongly preferred.

• Experience leading Finance, or a major component of Finance, at a high-growth tech, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or similarly complex company.

 Financial Expertise

• Exceptional financial modeling skills and a strong understanding of three-statement modeling, unit economics, cash flow, and capital allocation.

• A track record of building financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and analytical infrastructure in environments that are scaling quickly.

• Experience evaluating pricing, monetization, new products, investments, headcount, and other strategic decisions.

 Communication and Partnership

• A track record of communicating complex financial stories to investors, boards, and executive teams in ways that drive decisions and build confidence.

• Experience partnering directly with a CEO, executive team, and Board.

 Leadership and Team Building

• Experience building and developing high-performing Finance teams. Comfort operating without a fully defined playbook and building structure where it doesn’t exist.

 Judgment and Execution

• Strong commercial instincts. You understand that Finance exists to help the business make better decisions, not simply to explain what happened last quarter.

• The ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical level and an usually high bar for execution and bias towards action

• Strong conviction and judgment. You bring a point of view vs just presenting options.

 Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

 Base Pay Range

 $300,000 - $375,000 USD

 The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

 Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do

  • Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
  • Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
  • Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
  • Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
  • Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

Who You Are

  • You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
  • You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
  • You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
  • You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
  • You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
  • You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
  • You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
  • You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
  • You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.
  • You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Our mission is to make listening and watching feel effortless, personal, and joyful for hundreds of millions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We’re seeking a Principal Product Manager to help lead the consumer experience across Spotify’s formats, including books, podcasts, and music.   • You have experience building for mobile platforms such as iOS and Android, including complex user interfaces.

title: Director, Solutions Architecture EMEA
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As we continue to scale our business across EMEA, we are looking for an experienced Director, Solutions Architecture EMEA to lead our customer-facing Solutions Architecture organization across the region.

This is a leadership role responsible for building, developing and scaling a high-performing Solutions Architecture organization across multiple countries and markets. You will partner closely with EMEA Sales leadership, establish the operating model for the regional team, and ensure our Solutions Architects consistently deliver outstanding technical leadership and business value to customers. The scope of the role reflects where the business is today; as we scale, we expect the organization to specialize and subdivide, and this leader will help shape and staff that evolution.

We are looking for an experienced people leader who can build and empower strong teams while remaining close to customers, technology and our most strategic opportunities.

You’re welcome to work remotely from Europe.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build, lead and coach a high-performing Solutions Architecture team across multiple countries and markets in EMEA
  • Own the Solutions Architecture engagement model for EMEA in close partnership with regional Sales leadership, including how coverage and ownership are divided as the team expands
  • Establish clear priorities, operating mechanisms and performance expectations across the regional Solutions Architecture organization
  • Develop and scale the organization as the business grows, including hiring, coaching and developing senior technical professionals and future leaders
  • Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Infrastructure, Heads of AI/ML, Business leaders and other senior stakeholders across strategic customers and partners

title: Detection & Response Engineer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Detection and Response

The Detection and Response team is responsible for detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response across Nebius Cloud. Its goal is to improve and maintain Nebius's security monitoring capabilities, as well as to build and maintain an end-to-end Security Incident Response program - people, processes, and tools.

The Role

We're hiring a Detection & Response Engineer to build and run our D&R capability from the ground up. You'll work on detection engineering, threat intelligence, and incident response functions across Nebius Cloud.

You'll be responsible for detection development, handling complex security incidents, forensics, and shaping the D&R strategy.

What you’ll do

  • Detection development: maintain low false-positive and false-negative rates. Work closely with alerts consumers (20+ teams) to keep noise low and signal high, ensuring they can act quickly without missing genuine threats.
  • Architect and operate detection coverage across our cloud and bare-metal environments
  • Build and extend our internal D&R tools and pipelines - onboard new logs, build and automate response runbooks.
  • Integrate threat intelligence into detection logic and IR playbooks, tracking adversary TTPs relevant to Cloud infrastructure
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: scoping, containment, root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and controlling critical action items are closed to prevent future possible incidents.
  • Partner with Compliance and Engineering teams to detect real threats while meeting the needs of both engineers and regulators.
  • Define and report on D&R metrics: MTTD, MTTR, detection coverage, false positive rates, etc.
  • Build and maintain Security Incident Response program: people, processes, tools.
  • Build tools, runbooks, and on-call processes that scale as the company grows.

What we look for

  • 6+ years in security operations, detection engineering, or incident response.
  • Deep hands-on experience with cloud-native environments (Kubernetes, Linux workloads, container-based infrastructure).
  • Strong detection engineering skills: writing and tuning rules/detections in SIEM platforms (e.g., Chronicle, Splunk, Elastic) and SQL.
  • Experience building or operating SOAR workflows and automating response at scale (ideally with Golang and Temporal).
  • Working knowledge of threat intelligence frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Pyramid of Pain, Kill Chain) and how to operationalize them in detections.
  • Solid IR fundamentals: memory forensics, log analysis, network traffic analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Stakeholder management: able to coordinate across engineers, compliance, legal, executives during active incident phase. Serve as the primary owner and driver for complex changes, as a result of incidents post-mortem.

Nice to have

  • Experience with AI/ML and GPU clusters related threats.
  • Familiarity with eBPF-based detection or runtime security tooling (Falco, Tetragon).
  • Background in threat hunting.

Why this role at Nebius

  • Build D&R at a company scaling from startup to global infrastructure provider in real time.
  • Ability to evolve our internal D&R platform into a new cloud security product, delivering novel security observability for a range of neocloud customers - from big tech to AI startups.
  • Work alongside world-class engineers on infrastructure that powers frontier AI.
  • Competitive compensation with equity upside in a Nasdaq-listed, high-growth company.
  • Flexible, remote-first culture.

Hiring Process

  • Recruiter's chat (30mins)
  • Live-coding interview (60mins) to asses basic coding skills
  • Security interview (60mins) to asses domain expertise
  • Incident Response interview (90mins) to assess practical experience
  • Final interview to close the hiring process (45mins)

  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

description:
Headquarters: Remote US

 What We Do:

 Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

 Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

 Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

 Reports to: SDR Manager

 Location: Remote US

 Compensation Range: $58,500 base with on target earnings at $78,000 plus equity

 What You'll Do:

 Huntress is looking for a talented and passionate Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help fuel our continued growth. In this role, you will open doors for the Account Executive team by building relationships with managed service providers (MSPs) and managed security service providers (MSSPs), earning trust quickly, and turning early conversations into qualified meetings that move the pipeline forward. You are outcome-obsessed in how you work, with a clear eye on the right next step, the right partner fit, and the follow-through it takes to create real pipeline impact.

 In the daily rhythm of prospecting into the MSP and MSSP space, you bring warrior spirit. You stay steady through rejection, keep your standards high, and come back sharper on the next call. You also give a sh*t about the people on the other end of the phone, leading with honesty, curiosity, and respect as you help prospective partners understand the value Huntress can deliver to their business and their customers.

• Experience with outbound cold calling.

• Strong time management and the ability to prioritize competing tasks.

• Comfort working across CRM, prospecting tools, and multiple systems at the same time.

• Attention to detail when taking notes, setting meetings, and following the process.

• A coachable mindset and a genuine interest in continuing to grow your sales and cybersecurity knowledge.

• Curiosity about AI and the judgment to use it in practical ways that help you work faster and smarter in your day-to-day.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Priority application deadline: Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Early applications are heavily encouraged.

We’re growing at incredible speed, and expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. We’re hiring a Chief Technology Officer to lead the building and rebuilding of the technology, systems and ways of working that will enable a sustained $5B+ p/a operation.

You will build software that safely and securely moves billions of dollars to millions of vulnerable people in some of the poorest and highest need parts of the world. This will require applying excellent engineering, team building and organizational judgment to complex, high-stakes operations: identity and fraud management, machine learning on large but imperfect datasets (cell phone data, satellite imagery, government registries), mobile money integrations, low-connectivity environments, rapidly evolving requirements all in diverse regulatory environments and country contexts. You’ll need to keep our legacy technology stack stable and performant, while in parallel building new systems from the ground up for our next level of scale.

You will lead engineering, data, security and enterprise technology – with a small, mighty and rapidly growing engineering team of ~15, and the expectation that this can at least double to ~30 in the next 12 months if you want it to. You’ll report to a CEO with deep experience running technology companies, and partner with our VP Product.

This role is remote, with working hours between US Eastern Time and East African Time, and some preference for candidates in our office hubs of New York, London, or Nairobi.

What we’re looking for:

  • An exceptional hirer, manager and organizer of technical talent. Proven record identifying, hiring, developing and retaining excellent engineers and engineering leaders, and creating team processes that consistently deliver software with quality and velocity.
  • Deep technical judgment, applied close to the work. You can evaluate major designs, pressure-test architecture and build-vs-buy decisions, and recognize when a team is heading the wrong way, without becoming the primary implementer. Low-ego: you’ll investigate a problem yourself when that’s what the situation requires.
  • Business judgment and decisiveness under ambiguity. You’re not just a technical leader, you’re also a business executive. You understand the business, are a strong cross-functional partner, and have a history of good judgment when navigating tradeoffs of long vs. short term, speed, reliability, security, flexibility, cost, technical quality, and user impact.
  • AI first. You have a point of view on where AI meaningfully changes engineering productivity and organizational capability, and you’ve moved a team from experimentation to real, measured use. You can set the tools, culture, goals, and guardrails that leverage the opportunities and mitigate the risks of an AI first engineering culture.
  • Embody and set an example for GD values. We take our values incredibly seriously, and expect our leaders to embody, nurture, and promote them in the way they work and the teams they build.
  • Advantages, not requirements. Experience in an operationally complex or regulated domain (fintech, payments, humanitarian response, global development); systems involving financial controls, fraud risk, identity, or sensitive recipient data; operating across multiple countries, particularly lower-income or infrastructure-constrained ones; leading both modern product engineering and enterprise technology.

What you’ll do

  • Define our technology vision and target stack. Own the technical strategy for technology-first delivery at $5B+/year: architecture, platforms, build-vs-buy, and what we retire. Work with executive, product, finance, risk, and data leaders to turn program and product strategy into a sequenced, credible portfolio of technical investments.
  • Balance a demanding portfolio. You'll manage six workstreams that all matter and won't all move at once: (1) building our new cash delivery stack (remote-first verification, fraud prevention, massive volume) (2) stabilizing our legacy stack until switchover, then managing the migration; (3) donor-facing fundraising products; (4) our global emergency cash system (and eventual white-labelling of that product); (5) enterprise technology; (6) internal tooling, platform, and cybersecurity. Deciding sequencing and staffing across these (and saying "not yet" credibly) is the job.
  • Build and grow an exceptional technology organization. Recruit outstanding engineering and technology talent, design the org GiveDirectly needs at its next stage of scale (engineering, product, data, security, infrastructure, enterprise systems), and create the accountability, decision rights, and career paths to sustain high talent density. Grow the engineering team from 15 to ~30 with a lean but durable management structure.
  • Own the technical direction and quality bar. Guide consequential decisions on integrations, data, security, reliability, and technical debt. Ensure our systems can safely support a major increase in transaction volume, geographic reach, and organizational dependence on technology. Set a pragmatic quality bar appropriate to high-stakes financial delivery while preserving speed.
  • Lead across organizational boundaries. Serve as a member of GiveDirectly’s executive team, reporting to the CEO and bringing technology into major strategic and operating decisions. Help non-technical leaders understand technical constraints and costs, build credibility with country and functional leaders by understanding their realities, and force clarity when priorities, ownership, or tradeoffs are ambiguous.
  • Travel. Approximately 4–6 trips per year, including visits to GiveDirectly countries of operation.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy so pay is consistent across comparable roles.

Total Compensation (US) of $366,000 – $518,000 comprised of:

  • Base Salary: $300,000 – $375,000
  • Bonus: $45,000-$112,000 (bonus is % based and decided based on org-wide performance, we will share full methodology during the hiring process)
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: ~$21,000

Total Compensation (UK) of £225,000 – £317,000 comprised of:

  • Base Salary: £193,400 – £241,700
  • Bonus: £29,000 – £72,500 (bonus is % based and decided based on org-wide performance, we will share full methodology during the hiring process)
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Total Compensation (Kenya) of $333,000 – $467,000 comprised of:

  • Base Salary: $282,500 – $353,100
  • Bonus: $42,000 – $106,000 (bonus is % based and decided based on org-wide performance, we will share full methodology during the hiring process)
  • Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,453

If you are not based in one of the countries listed above, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing, reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@giv

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As an Advertising Account Manager, you will own the day-to-day planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing and retail media campaigns across a portfolio of enterprise and strategic clients in a variety of channels. You will serve as a subject matter expert on retail media platforms, digital advertising strategies, and/or performance metrics. Acting as a trusted advisor, you’ll collaborate closely with clients to align media tactics to business goals, while working cross-functionally to ensure accurate campaign setup, timely execution, and actionable insights. Your skillset ideally spans the ability to be a hands-on campaign manager within key channels while also elevating to own the client health and overall relationship on the channels that you own.

All team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of client accounts overseeing the strategy, planning execution and optimization of digital and retail media campaigns across major digital marketing and retail media platforms.
  • Translate client objectives into actionable media strategies that drive performance and measurable outcomes.
  • Set up, monitor, and optimize campaign performance, managing budgets, bids, and ad creatives.
  • Leverage deep knowledge of Rithum’s platform and tools to optimize client programs and outcomes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, expanding relationships with key stakeholders and decisionmakers while providing regular reporting and insights to clients, identifying opportunities for growth and improvement.
  • Partner with Client Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive, high-impact media programs.
  • Create, present, and execute media strategies to a variety of clients in different product categories.
  • Stay up to date with digital marketing and retail media trends, ad formats, and platform capabilities.
  • Educate clients on industry best practices and platform changes.

Qualifications

  • 1+ years hands-on of experience managing advertising campaigns on major platforms such as Amazon Advertising, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Walmart Connect for multiple clients
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and
  • strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to generate insights on performance, channel health, and industry trends to guide client strategy.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership and clients alike.
  • Experience working collaboratively on large teams and managing cross-functional projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and forecast advertising budgets, making data driven decisions to maximize efficiency and achieve performance targets across campaigns.
  • Strong AI fluency, with experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day workflows and processes to drive efficiency, enhance analysis, and scale impact.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
  • Agency experience strongly preferred.
  • 3+ years of progressive experience in digital marketing, media buying, or ecommerce advertising.
  • Experience working in an agency or SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with eCommerce platforms, digital merchandising, and attribution models.

Travel Required

Up to 10%.

Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. - Assist Privacy NFR to support colleagues and partners across the Firm with the intake, processing, redactions and quality assurance checks of request responses.

- Support Privacy NFR with oversight activity including monitoring of dashboards and production of metrics for reporting to colleagues, partners and governance groups.

- Support Privacy NFR by providing advice and guidance on global Data Subject Rights to key stakeholders across the Firm.

- Excellent organizational skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines.

title: Marketing Technology Engineer
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

Marketing Operations owns the systems the marketing organization runs on: the MarTech stack, the data that describes our funnel, and increasingly the AI agents that do the work. The Marketing Technology Engineer owns the automation and AI layer of that stack — building the agents and automations that remove manual work from the team, and making sure they keep running and keep producing output we can trust. This is a technical role inside a marketing function, and the marketing half is not optional.

The impact you'll have here:

  • Own the operating layer for marketing's agent fleet end to end — provisioning, output verification, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. Nothing counts as shipped until it has run for real and its output has been checked.

  • Design and build agentic processes, skills, and automations that remove manual work from the team, and decide — with marketing judgment — which are worth building at all.

  • Instrument what we build so usage, output, and value are visible to leadership, and so agents improve from feedback rather than staying frozen at launch.

  • Consolidate how core marketing concepts are defined across tools and agents — territory, lead scoring stages, MQL and MQA, pipeline stages, targets — so automations and dashboards cannot quietly disagree, including across two product lines.

  • Own the MarTech stack — configuration, administration, and integration — and build in a way the campaign execution team can extend without engineering support for routine work.

What we're looking for:

  • Prior marketing or marketing operations experience — required, not preferred. You already understand funnel and attribution logic, lead scoring, send-cadence and deliverability norms, and list hygiene and consent rules. This role has no downstream reviewer for marketing correctness.

  • You have personally operated something unattended. A pipeline, integration, or agent that ran on its own, broke without telling you, and taught you to verify output rather than trust a green status. Scale matters less than the scar tissue.

  • A track record of building production automation inside a GTM function — Clay, Zapier, Workato, n8n, or similar — where what you built was depended on by other people and you were the one who owned it.

  • Evidence you have moved from no-code stitching into code and repository practice: version control, code review, CI, testing, and deploying into a shared repo rather than a personal account.

  • Technical baseline: working proficiency in SQL and Python, solid REST API fundamentals, familiarity with secrets management for credentials and API keys, enough data-warehouse fluency (for example BigQuery) to query and reason about data models, and hands-on administration of HubSpot and Salesforce.

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience with Claude, or with n8n.

  • Experience building multi-step enrichment waterfalls in Clay or similar that others depend on.

  • Exposure to observability or data-quality practices — monitoring, alerting, freshness and anomaly checks — in any prior role.

  • Experience supporting more than one product line, where the same metric has to be correct in two motions at once.

About the Team:

  • Marketing Operations is a distributed, not distant team that owns the systems the marketing organization runs on.

  • The work is intellectually difficult because the same metric has to stay correct across two product lines and multiple tools and agents at once.

  • Ownership is high: this role makes consequential marketing decisions without a downstream reviewer.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000–$190,000 USD.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Blockchain Intelligence Analyst, Ransomware
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role:

We're looking for a Blockchain Intelligence Analyst to operate as a high-judgment, high-autonomy individual contributor specializing in ransomware. In this role, you'll leverage blockchain analytics, cyber threat intelligence, and cryptocurrency attribution to trace ransomware proceeds, identify threat actor infrastructure, and generate actionable intelligence that supports investigations, disruption efforts, and evidentiary workflows.

This is not a people-management role. We're looking for an experienced analyst who can independently lead complex investigations, develop high-confidence assessments, uncover novel attribution, and elevate the team's tradecraft through technical expertise, mentorship, and example.

You should be equally comfortable tracing funds across blockchains, identifying laundering and cash-out infrastructure, correlating technical, financial, and behavioral signals, and synthesizing fragmented data into clear, defensible intelligence that enables internal and external partners to make informed operational decisions.

The Impact You Will Have:

  • Produce impactful finished intelligence on ransomware actors, affiliates, facilitators, and laundering pathways, including actor profiles, lead packages, attribution assessments, and operational reporting suitable for investigative, executive, and partner audiences.

  • Lead complex end-to-end blockchain investigations from initial seed indicators such as victim payment addresses, deposit addresses, transactions, exchange exposure, infrastructure leads, or IP-linked activity through to full attribution and actionable recovery or disruption opportunities.

  • Trace ransomware-related funds across multiple blockchains, bridges, mixers, peel chains, and nested services, identifying controllers, counterparties, cash-out services, and recovery touchpoints.

  • Correlate on-chain activity with OSINT, threat intelligence, attribution partner data, and off-chain identity or infrastructure signals to build a complete picture of adversary behavior within the broader cybercrime ecosystem.

  • Own investigative workstreams from discovery through validation, escalation, and written production, including drafting intelligence products that are source-cited, auditable, and operationally useful.

  • Support TRM’s ransomware asset recovery mission by surfacing high-quality leads, identifying seizure or freeze opportunities, and helping partners move quickly before funds are off-ramped.

  • Drive analytical leadership across active ransomware investigations by prioritizing work, maintaining rigorous standards, and mentoring other analysts without formal people management responsibilities.

  • Partner closely with internal and external stakeholders, including investigators, threat intelligence teammates, product teams, and public-sector or private-sector partners, to ensure analytical outputs reflect real investigative tradecraft and support cross-functional operations.

  • Help strengthen TRM’s ransomware coverage by contributing new attribution, refining investigative methodologies, and improving repeatable workflows for lead generation and asset recovery support.

  • Support external briefings, customer or partner engagements, and capability-building sessions where ransomware tracing, attribution, and recovery tradecraft must be explained clearly and credibly.

What Success Looks Like:

  • You generate meaningful attribution, investigative leads, and recovery opportunities in ransomware cases where the answers are not obvious, and the financial trail is deliberately obscured.

  • You consistently produce finished intelligence that partners trust and use in operational, investigative, and strategic contexts.

  • Your work helps TRM and its partners move faster on high-priority ransomware activity without sacrificing rigor, auditability, or defensibility.

  • You improve team capability by mentoring peers, refining tradecraft, and strengthening repeatable workflows for ransomware investigations and asset recovery support.

  • You help make blockchain-enabled financial intelligence a differentiator in how TRM understands, attributes, and disrupts ransomware activity across the cybercrime ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5-8+ years of professional experience in blockchain intelligence, crypto investigations, cybercrime analysis, threat intelligence, financial crime investigations, or a comparable senior analytical role.

  • Blockchain tracing expertise — Deep hands-on experience tracing funds across multiple blockchains and through laundering or obfuscation techniques such as mixers, chain-hopping, bridges, peel chains, and layered cash-out behavior.

  • Extensive investigative tradecraft — Demonstrated ability to independently run complex investigations and synthesize findings into clear written intelligence products, including investigative assessments, lead packages, fund-flow analysis, and attribution reporting.

  • Ransomware domain expertise — including a deep understanding of the broader cybercrime ecosystem and the relationships among ransomware operators, affiliates, initial access brokers, malware developers, laundering networks, and cash-out services.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication — especially the ability to turn technically complex tracing findings into understandable, actionable intelligence for government and private-sector audiences.

  • Judgment and execution — Strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where timing matters and outputs must still stand up to scrutiny.

  • AI fluency — Experience leveraging AI tools and large language models (LLMs) to accelerate research, surface insights, and augment analytical workflows, with the ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in government, national security, law enforcement, incident response, or mature private-sector investigative or threat intelligence programs.

  • Familiarity with OSINT, cybercrime infrastructure research, and cross-domain analytical methods that combine blockchain activity with off-chain signals and adversary behavior.

  • Comfort with modern investigative tooling, including AI and structured data environments such as TRM, Maltego, Palantir, or similar platforms.

  • Experience conducting HUMINT collection and engaging threat actors via dark web forums and encrypted messaging platforms.

  • Experience mentoring peers, shaping analytical standards, or improving investigative workflows without formal people management.

  • Advanced practitioner-level knowledge of crypto forensics concepts such as manual demixing, smart contracts, bridges, Ethereum- and TRON-based investigations, and OSINT-based data extraction.

  • Recognized subject matter depth, broader organizational influence, and a track record of shaping methodology or high-priority investigative strategy beyond individual case execution.

Team Operating Rhythms

  • Weekly team syncs to align targeting priorities and review disruption opportunities

  • Daily async standups via Slack on active work, returns, and target packages in flight

  • Primary time zone overlap: US Eastern / Central

  • All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

  • Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

description:

 At Current

 At Current, we partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that drive meaningful business results. By bringing together strategy, design, production, and technology, we help organizations solve complex challenges and build experiences that create lasting impact.

 We're looking for a Senior Engineer (.NET) to build scalable, high-quality digital experiences across websites, platforms, and applications. You'll collaborate closely with strategists, designers, producers, and fellow engineers to deliver thoughtful technical solutions while contributing to architecture, code quality, and engineering best practices.

 What You'll Do

• Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code using modern .NET technologies and JavaScript

• Contribute to technical architecture, solution design, and implementation planning
